glosses: quatorze (set of four similar cards in piquet)
synonym of cuarta funeral (the right of a church to part of the payment for its parishioners' funeral and mass services when held elsewhere)
battalion (particularly a battalion forming exactly one-fourth of a company)

examples.text: Vamos a ensayar la cuarta escena.
He visto la cuarta temporada de Expediente X.
examples.en: I watched the 4th season of X-files.

examples.text: España es la cuarta economía más grande de la Eurozona.
examples.en: Spain is the Eurozone's fourth-largest economy.

examples.text: El turismo, las ventas al por menor y las finanzas abarcan más de tres cuartas partes del PIB.
examples.en: Tourism, retail sales, and finance comprise more than three-quarters of GDP.
